who.text: God, Moses and Israel.

where.text: The plains of Moab across the Jordan from Canaan.

when.text: Traditonally near the end of Moses' life; compositional dating is disputed.

what.text: Moses renews the covenant with Israel on the plains of Moab, recounting God's acts, restating the law and setting blessing and curse before the people. Genre: Covenant sermons (farewell addresses and law).

before.text: Concludes the wilderness period narrated in Numbers.

stakes.text: Calls a new generation to covenant loyalty as they enter the land.
